title: ShadowSaaS Surface Scanner output
description: The JSON document ShadowSaaS writes via -o/--output. This is TrustLeak's input contract — documented here so a future ShadowSaaS change that breaks this shape is caught at import time, not silently misread.

warnings.description: Present only when a target was aborted (e.g. proxy certificate error). TrustLeak should surface these, not silently import a partial result as if it were complete.

relevant_headers.description: Added in ShadowSaaS's relevant_headers patch. Absent entirely in output from before that patch — not required here so older files still validate; the importer treats a missing key the same as an empty object.

relevant_body_refs.description: Added in ShadowSaaS's relevant_body_refs patch (iframe/script/form references extracted from the HTML body ShadowSaaS already fetched). Absent entirely in output from before that patch — not required here so older files still validate; the importer treats a missing key the same as an empty object.
